svg.aria-label: How the AQI number is built: each of six pollutants (PM2.5, PM10, NO2, SO2, CO, ozone) gets its own sub-index; the Air Quality Index reports only the single worst sub-index, so the headline number hides which pollutant is driving it.
svg.text: How the AQI number is built
one index, six pollutants — it always reports the worst
Two cities both at "200" can have completely different air — the label hides which pollutant is driving it.
